pokedex.1: For some time after its birth, it grows by gaining nourishment from the seed on its back.
pokedex.2: When the bud on its back starts swelling, a sweet aroma wafts to indicate the flower’s coming bloom.
pokedex.3: After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.
pokedex.4: The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of its life. If healthy, its tail burns intensely.
pokedex.5: In the rocky mountains where CHARMELEON live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.
pokedex.6: It is said that CHARIZARD’s fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.
pokedex.7: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.
pokedex.8: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.
pokedex.9: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.
pokedex.10: It releases a stench from its red antenna to repel enemies. It grows by molting repeatedly.
pokedex.11: A steel-hard shell protects its tender body. It quietly endures hardships while awaiting evolution.
pokedex.12: It loves the honey of flowers and can locate flower patches that have even tiny amounts of pollen.
pokedex.13: It eats its weight in leaves every day. It fends off attackers with the needle on its head.
pokedex.14: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.
pokedex.15: Its best attack involves flying around at high speed, striking with poison needles, then flying off.
pokedex.16: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.
pokedex.17: It flies over its wide territory in search of prey, downing it with its highly developed claws.
pokedex.18: By flapping its wings with all its might, PIDGEOT can make a gust of wind capable of bending tall trees.
pokedex.19: Cautious in the extreme, its hardy vitality lets it live in any kind of environment.
pokedex.20: It whittles its constantly growing fangs by gnawing on hard things. It can chew apart cinder walls.
pokedex.21: It flaps its small wings busily to fly. Using its beak, it searches in grass for prey.
pokedex.22: It has the stamina to fly all day on its broad wings. It fights by using its sharp beak.
pokedex.23: It sneaks through grass without making a sound and strikes unsuspecting prey from behind.
pokedex.24: The pattern on its belly is for intimidation. It constricts foes while they are frozen in fear.
pokedex.25: It lives in forests with others. It stores electricity in the pouches on its cheeks.
pokedex.26: It turns aggressive if it has too much electricity in its body. It discharges power through its tail.
pokedex.27: To protect itself from attackers, it curls up into a ball. It lives in arid regions with minimal rainfall.
pokedex.28: It curls up, then rolls into foes with its back. Its sharp spines inflict severe damage.
pokedex.29: While it does not prefer to fight, even one drop of the poison it secretes from barbs can be fatal.
pokedex.30: When it senses danger, it raises all the barbs on its body. These barbs grow slower than NIDORINO’s.
pokedex.31: Its entire body is armored with hard scales. It will protect the young in its burrow with its life.
pokedex.32: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.
pokedex.33: It has a violent disposition and stabs foes with its horn, which oozes poison upon impact.
pokedex.34: One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone pole as if it were a matchstick.
pokedex.35: Thought to live with others on quiet mountains, it is popular for its adorable nature.
pokedex.36: Rarely seen by people, it is said to be drawn by the full moon to play at deserted lakes.
pokedex.37: It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails split from their tips to make more tails.
pokedex.38: Its nine tails are said to be imbued with a mystic power. It can live for a thousand years.
pokedex.39: When it wavers its big, round eyes, it begins singing a lullaby that makes everyone drowsy.
pokedex.40: Its fine fur feels sublime to the touch. It can expand its body by inhaling air.
pokedex.41: Even though it has no eyes, it can sense obstacles using ultrasonic waves it emits from its mouth.
pokedex.42: It loves the blood of humans and Pokémon. It flies around at night in search of neck veins.
pokedex.43: It often plants its root feet in the ground during the day and sows seeds as it walks about at night.
pokedex.44: The honey it drools from its mouth smells so atrocious, it can curl noses more than a mile away.
pokedex.45: Its petals are the largest in the world. As it walks, it scatters extremely allergenic pollen.
pokedex.46: Mushrooms named tochukaso grow on its back. They grow along with the host PARAS.
pokedex.47: A mushroom grown larger than the host’s body controls PARASECT. It scatters poisonous spores.
pokedex.48: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.
pokedex.49: It flutters its wings to scatter dustlike scales. The scales leach toxins if they contact skin.
pokedex.50: A Pokémon that lives underground. Because of its dark habitat, it is repelled by bright sunlight.
pokedex.51: Its three heads move alternately, driving it through tough soil to depths of over 60 miles.
pokedex.52: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.
pokedex.53: A very haughty Pokémon. Among fans, the size of the jewel in its forehead is a topic of much talk.
pokedex.54: If its usual headache worsens, it starts exhibiting odd powers. It can’t remember doing so, however.
pokedex.55: A Pokémon that lives in lakes. It swims faster than any human swimming champion.
pokedex.56: It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.
pokedex.57: It grows angry if you see its eyes and gets angrier if you run. If you beat it, it gets even madder.
pokedex.58: A Pokémon with a loyal nature. It will remain motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.
pokedex.59: Its proud and regal appearance has captured the hearts of people since long ago.
pokedex.60: Its skin is so thin, its internal organs are visible. It has trouble walking on its newly grown feet.
pokedex.61: The spiral pattern on its belly subtly undulates. Staring at it gradually causes drowsiness.
pokedex.62: With its extremely tough muscles, it can keep swimming in the Pacific Ocean without resting.
pokedex.63: It sleeps for 18 hours a day. Even when awake, it teleports itself while remaining seated.
pokedex.64: If one is nearby, an eerie shadow appears on TV screens. Seeing the shadow is said to bring bad luck.
pokedex.65: Its superb memory lets it recall everything it has experienced from birth. Its IQ exceeds 5,000.
pokedex.66: It hefts a GRAVELER repeatedly to strengthen its entire body. It uses every type of martial arts.
pokedex.67: MACHOKE’s boundless power is very dangerous, so it wears a belt that suppresses its energy.
pokedex.68: It punches with its four arms at blinding speed. It can launch 1,000 punches in two seconds.
pokedex.69: It prefers hot and humid environments. It is quick at capturing prey with its vines.
pokedex.70: A Pokémon that appears to be a plant. It captures unwary prey by dousing them with a toxic powder.
pokedex.71: It pools in its mouth a fluid with a honeylike scent, which is really an acid that dissolves anything.
pokedex.72: Its body is virtually composed of water. It shoots strange beams from its crystal-like eyes.
pokedex.73: With 80 tentacles for ensnaring victims, it prevents escape until the prey is weakened by poison.
pokedex.74: Many live on mountain trails and remain half buried while keeping an eye on climbers.
pokedex.75: GRAVELER make their homes on sheer cliff faces by gouging out numerous horizontal holes.
pokedex.76: It sheds its hide once a year. Its boulderlike body is so tough, even dynamite can’t harm it.
pokedex.77: About an hour after birth, its fiery mane and tail grow out, giving it an impressive appearance.
pokedex.78: It gallops at nearly 150 mph. With its mane blazing ferociously, it races as if it were an arrow.
pokedex.79: Although slow, it is skilled at fishing with its tail. It does not feel pain if its tail is bitten.
pokedex.80: Though usually dim witted, it seems to become inspired if the SHELLDER on its tail bites down.
pokedex.81: The units at its sides generate electromagnetic waves that keep it airborne. It feeds on electricity.
pokedex.82: It is actually three MAGNEMITE linked by magnetism. A group can set off a magnetic storm.
pokedex.83: It can’t live without the stalk it holds. That’s why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.
pokedex.84: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.
pokedex.85: When DODUO evolves into this odd breed, one of its heads splits into two. It runs at nearly 40 mph.
pokedex.86: A Pokémon that lives on icebergs. It swims in the sea using the point on its head to break up ice.
pokedex.87: In snow, the pure white coat covering its body obscures it from predators.
pokedex.88: It was born when sludge in a dirty stream was exposed to the moon’s X-rays. It appears among filth.
pokedex.89: A toxic fluid seeps from its body. The fluid instantly kills plants and trees on contact.
pokedex.90: It swims backward by opening and closing its two shells. Its large tongue is always kept hanging out.
pokedex.91: It fights by keeping its shell tightly shut for protection and by shooting spikes to repel foes.
pokedex.92: This Pokémon’s body is 95% made up of gases, which are blown away by strong gusts of wind.
pokedex.93: It can slip through any obstacle. It lurks inside walls to keep an eye on its foes.
pokedex.94: It hides in shadows. It is said that if GENGAR is hiding, it cools the area by nearly 10 degrees F.
pokedex.95: When it travels underground, it causes rumbling and tremors. It can move at 50 mph.
pokedex.96: It can tell what people are dreaming by sniffing with its big nose. It loves fun dreams.
pokedex.97: Seeing its swinging pendulum can induce sleep in three seconds, even in someone who just woke up.
pokedex.98: It lives in burrows dug on sandy beaches. Its pincers fully grow back if they are broken in battle.
pokedex.99: The larger pincer has 10,000- horsepower strength. However, it is so heavy, it is difficult to aim.
pokedex.100: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on touch.
pokedex.101: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.
pokedex.102: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.
pokedex.103: It is called “The Walking Jungle.” If a head grows too big, it falls off and becomes an EXEGGCUTE.
pokedex.104: When it thinks of its dead mother, it cries. Its crying makes the skull it wears rattle hollowly.
pokedex.105: From its birth, this savage Pokémon constantly holds bones. It is skilled in using them as weapons.
pokedex.106: Its legs can stretch double. First-time foes are startled by its extensible reach.
pokedex.107: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.
pokedex.108: Instead of hands, it uses its tongue, which is twice its height. Its sticky saliva grips anything.
pokedex.109: Lighter-than-air gases in its body keep it aloft. The gases not only smell, they are also explosive.
pokedex.110: It grows by feeding on gases released by garbage. Though very rare, triplets have been found.
pokedex.111: Its body is clad in a thick hide, and its tackles topple buildings. Unfortunately, it is not smart.
pokedex.112: Its brain developed after it stood up on its hind legs. Its drill horn bores tunnels through solid rock.
pokedex.113: It is said to deliver happiness. Being compassionate, it shares its eggs with injured people.
pokedex.114: It is shrouded by blue vines. No one has seen the face hidden behind this growth of vines.
pokedex.115: It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets the baby out to play only when it feels safe.
pokedex.116: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.
pokedex.117: Its spines provide protection. Its fins and bones are prized as traditional medicine ingredients.
pokedex.118: It swims elegantly by flittering its tail fin as if it were a dress. It has the look of a queen.
pokedex.119: It makes its nest by hollowing out boulders in streams with its horn. It defends its eggs with its life.
pokedex.120: If its body is torn, it can grow back if the red core remains. The core flashes at midnight.
pokedex.121: At the center of its body is a red core, which sends mysterious radio signals into the night sky.
pokedex.122: It is a pantomime expert that can create invisible but solid walls using miming gestures.
pokedex.123: It is nearly impossible to parry its attacking scythes. Its movements are like a ninja’s.
pokedex.124: Its cries sound like human speech. However, it is impossible to tell what it is trying to say.
pokedex.125: Half of all blackouts occur when this Pokémon appears at power plants and eats electricity.
pokedex.126: Born in the spout of a volcano, its body is covered by flames that shimmer like the sun.
pokedex.127: It grips prey with its pincers until the prey is torn in half. What it can’t tear, it tosses far.
pokedex.128: Once it takes aim at its foe, it makes a headlong charge. It is famous for its violent nature.
pokedex.129: It is said to be the world’s weakest Pokémon. No one knows why it has managed to survive.
pokedex.130: Once it appears, its rage never settles until it has razed the fields and mountains around it.
pokedex.131: It loves crossing the sea with people and Pokémon on its back. It understands human speech.
pokedex.132: It has the ability to reconstitute its entire cellular structure to transform into whatever it sees.
pokedex.133: A rare Pokémon that adapts to harsh environments by taking on different evolutionary forms.
pokedex.134: It has evolved to be suitable for an aquatic life. It can invisibly melt away into water.
pokedex.135: It controls 10,000-volt power and can raise all the fur on its body as if it were sharp needles.
pokedex.136: It has a flame sac in its body. Its body temperature tops 1,650 degrees Fahrenheit before battle.
pokedex.137: The world’s first artificially created Pokémon. It can travel through electronic space.
pokedex.138: A Pokémon that was resurrected from a fossil using modern science. It swam in ancient seas.
pokedex.139: It is thought that this Pokémon became extinct because its spiral shell grew too large.
pokedex.140: It is thought to have inhabited beaches 300 million years ago. It is protected by a stiff shell.
pokedex.141: It is thought that this Pokémon came onto land because its prey adapted to life on land.
pokedex.142: A Pokémon that roamed the skies in the dinosaur era. Its teeth are like saw blades.
pokedex.143: Its stomach can digest any kind of food, even if it happens to be moldy or rotten.
pokedex.144: A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.
pokedex.145: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.
pokedex.146: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. It is said that its appearance indicates the coming of spring.
pokedex.147: It is called the “Mirage Pokémon” because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.
pokedex.148: If its body takes on an aura, the weather changes instantly. It is said to live in seas and lakes.
pokedex.149: It is said to make its home somewhere in the sea. It guides crews of shipwrecks to shore.
pokedex.150: A Pokémon created by recombining MEW’s genes. It’s said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.
pokedex.151: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe MEW to be the ancestor of Pokémon.
pokedex.152: It uses the leaf on its head to determine the temperature and humidity. It loves to sunbathe.
pokedex.153: The buds that ring its neck give off a spicy aroma that perks people up.
pokedex.154: Its breath has the fantastic ability to revive dead plants and flowers.
pokedex.155: It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on its back burn more vigorously.
pokedex.156: It intimidates foes with the heat of its flames. The fire burns more strongly when it readies to fight.
pokedex.157: It attacks using blasts of fire. It creates heat shimmers with intense fire to hide itself.
pokedex.158: It has the habit of biting anything with its developed jaws. Even its Trainer needs to be careful.
pokedex.159: Once it bites down, it won’t let go until it loses its fangs. New fangs quickly grow into place.
pokedex.160: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.
pokedex.161: It has a very nervous nature. It stands up high on its tail so it can scan wide areas.
pokedex.162: The mother puts its offspring to sleep by curling up around them. It corners foes with speed.
pokedex.163: It always stands on one foot. Even when attacked, it does not brace itself using both feet.
pokedex.164: Its eyes are special. They can pick out objects as long as there is the tiniest amount of light.
pokedex.165: It is so timid, it can’t move if it isn’t with a swarm of others. It conveys its feelings with scent.
pokedex.166: It uses starlight as energy. When more stars appear at night, the patterns on its back grow larger.
pokedex.167: It sets a trap by spinning a web with thin but strong silk. It waits motionlessly for prey to arrive.
pokedex.168: It attaches silk to its prey and sets it free. Later, it tracks the silk to the prey and its friends.
pokedex.169: Having four wings enables it to fly faster and more quietly. It turns active when the night comes.
pokedex.170: It discharges positive and negative electricity from its antenna tips to shock its foes.
pokedex.171: LANTURN’s light can shine up from great depths. It is nicknamed “The Deep-Sea Star.”
pokedex.172: The electric pouches on its cheeks are still small. They cannot store much electricity yet.
pokedex.173: Its silhouette is like a star. It is believed to arrive riding on shooting stars.
pokedex.174: It has a soft and bouncy body. Once it starts bouncing, it becomes impossible to stop.
pokedex.175: Its shell is said to be stuffed with happiness that it shares with kindhearted people.
pokedex.176: It is said to appear in front of kindly people to scatter a glowing down called “joy dust.”
pokedex.177: It picks food from cactus plants, deftly avoiding buds and spines. It seems to skip about to move.
pokedex.178: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun’s movement all day.
pokedex.179: Its fluffy coat swells to double when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.
pokedex.180: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.
pokedex.181: The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden days, people sent signals using the tail’s light.
pokedex.182: When the heavy rainfall season ends, it is drawn out by warm sunlight to dance in the open.
pokedex.183: Using its tail as a float, it dives underwater. It likes eating plants that grow on river bottoms.
pokedex.184: It lives in rivers and lakes. In water, its coloring and patterns trick the vision of foes.
pokedex.185: Despite appearing to be a tree, its body is closer to rocks and stones. It is very weak to water.
pokedex.186: It gathers groups of others as their leader. Its cries make POLIWAG obey.
pokedex.187: It drifts on winds. It is said that when HOPPIP gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.
pokedex.188: It blooms when the weather warms. It floats in the sky to soak up as much sunlight as possible.
pokedex.189: Blown by seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.
pokedex.190: It uses its tail to pluck fruits that are out of reach. Its tail is more adept than its real hands.
pokedex.191: It suddenly falls out of the sky in the morning. A year after a cold summer, their population explodes.
pokedex.192: It gets energy from warm sunlight and is known for its habit of moving in pursuit of it.
pokedex.193: Its eyes can see 360 degrees without moving its head. It won’t miss prey--even those behind it.
pokedex.194: It lives in cold water, half burying itself in mud at the bottom to sleep.
pokedex.195: It has a sluggish nature. It lies at the river’s bottom, waiting for prey to stray into its mouth.
pokedex.196: Its fur has the look and feel of velvet. The orb on its forehead glows when it uses psycho-power.
pokedex.197: The light of the moon changed EEVEE’s genetic structure. It lurks in darkness for prey.
pokedex.198: It is believed that seeing this Pokémon at night will bring about ominous occurrences.
pokedex.199: Being bitten by SHELLDER gave it intelligence comparable to that of award-winning scientists.
pokedex.200: It loves to sneak up on people late at night, then startle them with its shrieklike cry.
pokedex.201: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.
pokedex.202: It desperately tries to keep its black tail hidden. It is said to be proof the tail hides a secret.
pokedex.203: Its tail also has a small brain. It bites to repel any foe trying to sneak up on it from behind.
pokedex.204: It looks just like a pinecone. Its shell protects it from bird Pokémon that peck it by mistake.
pokedex.205: It is encased in a steel shell. Its peering eyes are all that can be seen of its mysterious innards.
pokedex.206: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.
pokedex.207: It sails on the winds with its limbs extended to strike from the sky. It aims for the prey’s face.
pokedex.208: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.
pokedex.209: Small Pokémon flee from its scary face. It is, however, considered by women to be cute.
pokedex.210: It is timid in spite of its looks. If it becomes enraged, however, it will strike with its huge fangs.
pokedex.211: It shoots the poison spines on its body in all directions. Its round form makes it a poor swimmer.
pokedex.212: It has a steel-hard body. It intimidates foes by upraising its eye-patterned pincers.
pokedex.213: It stores berries in its shell. The berries eventually ferment to become delicious juices.
pokedex.214: It gathers in forests to search for tree sap, its favorite food. It’s strong enough to hurl foes.
pokedex.215: It feeds on eggs stolen from nests. Its sharply hooked claws rip vulnerable spots on prey.
pokedex.216: It lets honey soak into its paws so it can lick them all the time. Every set of paws tastes unique.
pokedex.217: In its territory, it leaves scratches on trees that bear delicious berries or fruits.
pokedex.218: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn’t keep moving, its body will cool and harden.
pokedex.219: Its body temperature is roughly 18,000 degrees F. Flames spout from gaps in its hardened shell.
pokedex.220: It loves eating mushrooms that grow under dead grass. It also finds hot springs while foraging.
pokedex.221: Its shaggy coat makes it unable to see. It checks surroundings with its sensitive nose instead.
pokedex.222: Many live in the clean seas of the south. They apparently can’t live in polluted waters.
pokedex.223: It squirts water forcefully from its mouth to shoot down flying prey.
pokedex.224: It lives in the gaps of boulders and in holes on the seafloor. Its suction cups grip prey tightly.
pokedex.225: It carries food rolled up in its tail. It has the habit of sharing food with people lost in mountains.
pokedex.226: When the waves are calm, one may encounter a swarm of MANTINE swimming as if they are in flight.
pokedex.227: Despite being clad entirely in iron-hard armor, it flies at speeds over 180 mph.
pokedex.228: It conveys its feelings using different cries. It works in a pack to cleverly take down prey.
pokedex.229: Long ago, people imagined its eerie howls to be the call of the grim reaper.
pokedex.230: It lives in caves on the seafloor and creates giant whirlpools every time it moves.
pokedex.231: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.
pokedex.232: It attacks by curling up, then rolling into its foe. It can blow apart a house in one hit.
pokedex.233: With planetary development software installed, it became capable of working in space.
pokedex.234: Staring at its antlers creates an odd sensation as if one were being drawn into their centers.
pokedex.235: It marks its territory by using its tail like a paintbrush. There are more than 5,000 different marks.
pokedex.236: It is famous for its eagerness to fight and always nurses injuries from challenging larger foes.
pokedex.237: It fights while spinning like a top. The centrifugal force boosts its destructive power by ten.
pokedex.238: It tests everything by touching with its lips, which remember what it likes and dislikes.
pokedex.239: It generates electricity by whirling its arms. However, it can’t store the energy it makes.
pokedex.240: Its body temperature is around 1,100 degrees F. It is healthy if it is breathing yellow flames.
pokedex.241: It is said that kids who drink MILTANK’s milk grow up to become hearty, healthy adults.
pokedex.242: This kindhearted Pokémon nurses sick Pokémon to health. It senses feelings of sadness.
pokedex.243: It is said to have fallen with lightning. It can fire thunderbolts from the rain clouds on its back.
pokedex.244: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.
pokedex.245: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.
pokedex.246: A Pokémon that eats soil. Once it has eaten a large mountain, it goes to sleep so it can grow.
pokedex.247: Its body is as hard as bedrock. By venting pressurized gas, it can launch itself like a rocket.
pokedex.248: If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.
pokedex.249: It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.
pokedex.250: Its feathers are in seven colors. It is said that anyone seeing it is promised eternal happiness.
pokedex.251: It has the power to travel across time, but it is said to appear only in peaceful times.
pokedex.252: The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny spikes, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.
pokedex.253: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.
pokedex.254: The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down thick trees. It is without peer in jungle combat.
pokedex.255: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees F.
pokedex.256: Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.
pokedex.257: Flames spout from its wrists, enveloping its knuckles. Its punches scorch its foes.
pokedex.258: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.
pokedex.259: Its sturdy legs give it sure footing, even in mud. It burrows into dirt to sleep.
pokedex.260: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.
pokedex.261: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.
pokedex.262: It chases down prey in a pack. It will never disobey the commands of a skilled Trainer.
pokedex.263: It walks in zigzag fashion. It is good at finding items in the grass and even in the ground.
pokedex.264: It charges prey at speeds over 60 mph. However, because it can only run straight, it often fails.
pokedex.265: It loves to eat leaves. If it is attacked by a STARLY, it will defend itself with its spiked rear.
pokedex.266: It anchors itself by wrapping twigs with the silk from its body. It motionlessly awaits evolution.
pokedex.267: It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to drain the prey’s fluids.
pokedex.268: It is hot inside its cocoon. All the cells in its body create the energy for it to evolve.
pokedex.269: A nocturnal Pokémon. Drawn by streetlights, they messily eat the leaves of trees lining boulevards.
pokedex.270: It looks like an aquatic plant and serves as a ferry to Pokémon that can’t swim.
pokedex.271: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.
pokedex.272: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can’t help breaking out into a dance.
pokedex.273: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.
pokedex.274: The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners uneasy. It lives deep in forests.
pokedex.275: By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of 100 ft/second that can level houses.
pokedex.276: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.
pokedex.277: It circles the sky in search of prey. When it spots one, it dives steeply to catch the prey.
pokedex.278: It makes its nest on steep sea cliffs. Riding updrafts, it soars to great heights.
pokedex.279: It dips its large bill in the sea, then scoops up numerous prey along with water.
pokedex.280: It uses the horns on its head to sense human emotions. It is said to appear in front of cheerful people.
pokedex.281: It is highly perceptive of its Trainer’s feelings. It dances when it is feeling happy.
pokedex.282: It will try to guard its trusted Trainer with its life. It has the ability to see the future.
pokedex.283: It appears as if it is skating on water. It draws prey with a sweet scent from the tip of its head.
pokedex.284: Its antennae have eye patterns on them. Its four wings enable it to hover and fly in any direction.
pokedex.285: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over if inhaled.
pokedex.286: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.
pokedex.287: It spends nearly all its time in a day sprawled out. Just seeing it makes one drowsy.
pokedex.288: Its heart beats at a tenfold tempo, so it cannot sit still for even a moment.
pokedex.289: The world’s laziest Pokémon. When it is lounging, it is actually saving energy for striking back.
pokedex.290: It grows underground, sensing its surroundings using antennae instead of its virtually blind eyes.
pokedex.291: Because it moves so quickly, it sometimes becomes unseeable. It congregates around tree sap.
pokedex.292: A discarded bug shell that came to life. Peering into the crack on its back is said to steal one’s spirit.
pokedex.293: Usually, its cries are like quiet murmurs. If frightened, it shrieks at the same volume as a jet plane.
pokedex.294: The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks. It stamps its feet to power up.
pokedex.295: Its howls can be heard over six miles away. It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on its body.
pokedex.296: It toughens its body by slamming into thick trees. Many snapped trees can be found near its nest.
pokedex.297: It loves to match power with big-bodied Pokémon. It can knock a truck flying with its arm thrusts.
pokedex.298: A Pokémon that lives by water. It moves quickly on land by bouncing on its big tail.
pokedex.299: Its nose is a magnet. As a result, this Pokémon always keeps its face pointing north.
pokedex.300: It can’t stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.
pokedex.301: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.
pokedex.302: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.
pokedex.303: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.
pokedex.304: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.
pokedex.305: For food, it digs up iron ore. It smashes its steely body against others to fight over territory.
pokedex.306: While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.
pokedex.307: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.
pokedex.308: Through yoga training, it has honed its sixth sense. Its movements are elegant.
pokedex.309: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.
pokedex.310: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.
pokedex.311: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.
pokedex.312: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.
pokedex.313: It communicates with others by lighting up its rear at night. It loves ILLUMISE’s sweet aroma.
pokedex.314: With its sweet aroma, it guides VOLBEAT to draw signs with light in the night sky.
pokedex.315: ROSELIA raised on clean drinking water are known to grow vividly colored flowers.
pokedex.316: Almost all its body is its stomach. Its harsh digestive juices quickly dissolve anything it swallows.
pokedex.317: It swallows anything whole. It sweats toxic fluids from its follicles to douse foes.
pokedex.318: They swarm any foe that invades their territory. Their sharp fangs can tear out boat hulls.
pokedex.319: Its fangs rip through sheet iron. It swims at 75 mph and is known as “The Bully of the Sea.”
pokedex.320: On sunny days, it lands on beaches to bounce like a ball and play. It spouts water from its nose.
pokedex.321: The biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive to a depth of almost 10,000 feet on only one breath.
pokedex.322: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.
pokedex.323: It has volcanoes on its back. If magma builds up in its body, it shudders, then erupts violently.
pokedex.324: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.
pokedex.325: It bounces constantly, using its tail like a spring. The shock of bouncing keeps its heart beating.
pokedex.326: It uses black pearls to amplify its psycho-power. It does an odd dance to gain control over foes.
pokedex.327: No two SPINDA have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.
pokedex.328: It makes a conical pit in desert sand and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.
pokedex.329: It violently shudders its wings, generating ultrasonic waves to induce headaches in people.
pokedex.330: It whips up sandstorms with powerful flaps of its wings. It is known as “The Desert Spirit.”
pokedex.331: By storing water in its body, this desert dweller can survive for 30 days without water.
pokedex.332: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day’s desert heat.
pokedex.333: Its wings are like cotton tufts. If it perches on someone’s head, it looks like a cotton hat.
pokedex.334: It looks like a fluffy cloud when it is in flight. It hums with its soprano voice.
pokedex.335: It has feuded with SEVIPER for many generations. Its sharp claws are its biggest weapons.
pokedex.336: For many generations, it has feuded with ZANGOOSE. It whets its bladed tail on rocks for battle.
pokedex.337: Because it turns active on nights of the full moon, it is said to have some link to the lunar phases.
pokedex.338: A new Pokémon species, rumored to be from the sun. It gives off light while spinning.
pokedex.339: It coats its entire body with a slimy fluid so it can squirm and slip away if grabbed.
pokedex.340: It is very territorial. It repels foes by setting off tremors that extend over a three-mile radius.
pokedex.341: Its hardy vitality enables it to adapt to any environment. Its pincers will never release prey.
pokedex.342: It is a ruffian that uses its pincers to pick up and toss out other Pokémon from its pond.
pokedex.343: It moves by spinning on its foot. It is a rare Pokémon that was discovered in ancient ruins.
pokedex.344: An ancient clay figurine that came to life as a Pokémon from exposure to a mysterious ray of light.
pokedex.345: It lived on the seafloor 100 million years ago and was reanimated scientifically.
pokedex.346: It lives in the shallows of warm seas. When the tide goes out, it digs up prey from beaches.
pokedex.347: A Pokémon ancestor that was reanimated from a fossil. It lived in the sea and hunted with claws.
pokedex.348: It went ashore after evolving. Its entire body is clad in a sturdy armor.
pokedex.349: It is famous for its shabby appearance. While populous, they tend to cluster in set locations.
pokedex.350: When people bicker, it is said to arise from the depths of lakes to becalm violent hearts.
pokedex.351: Its appearance changes with the weather. Recently, its molecules were found to be just like water.
pokedex.352: It can freely change its body’s color. The zigzag pattern on its belly doesn’t change, however.
pokedex.353: It loves vengeful emotions and hangs in rows under the eaves of houses where vengeful people live.
pokedex.354: A doll that became a Pokémon over its grudge from being junked. It seeks the child that disowned it.
pokedex.355: It doggedly pursues its prey wherever it goes. However, the chase is abandoned at sunrise.
pokedex.356: Its body is hollow. It is said that those who look into its body are sucked into the void.
pokedex.357: Because it continually ate only its favorite fruit, the fruit started growing around its neck.
pokedex.358: To knock foes flying, it makes the air shudder with its cries. It converses using seven cries.
pokedex.359: It senses coming disasters and appears before people only to warn them of impending danger.
pokedex.360: It grows strong by pushing up against others en masse. It loves eating sweet fruit.
pokedex.361: In the snow country, certain folklore says a house will prosper if a SNORUNT lives there.
pokedex.362: To protect itself, it clads its body in an armor of ice, made by freezing moisture in the air.
pokedex.363: It rolls across ice floes to reach shore because its body is poorly shaped for swimming.
pokedex.364: It habitually spins things on its nose. By doing so, it learns textures and odors.
pokedex.365: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.
pokedex.366: It makes a single pearl during its lifetime. The pearl is said to amplify psychic power.
pokedex.367: It lives deep in the sea. With a tail shaped like a small fish, it attracts unsuspecting prey.
pokedex.368: It lives at the bottom of the sea. In the springtime, its pink body turns more vivid for some reason.
pokedex.369: A rare Pokémon discovered during a deep-sea exploration. It has not changed in over 100 million years.
pokedex.370: It lives in warm seas. It is said that a couple finding this Pokémon will be blessed with eternal love.
pokedex.371: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.
pokedex.372: Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun changing. The shell peels off the instant it evolves.
pokedex.373: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changed, and wings grew out.
pokedex.374: It converses with others by using magnetic pulses. In a swarm, they move in perfect unison.
pokedex.375: It is formed by two BELDUM joining together. Its steel body won’t be scratched if it collides with a jet.
pokedex.376: METANG combined to form it. With four brains, it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.
pokedex.377: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, it attaches rocks to repair itself.
pokedex.378: Its body is made of ice from the ice age. It controls frigid air of -328 degrees Fahrenheit.
pokedex.379: Tempered by pressure underground over tens of thousands of years, its body cannot be scratched.
pokedex.380: Its body is covered with a down that can refract light in such a way that it becomes invisible.
pokedex.381: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.
pokedex.382: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.
pokedex.383: It had been asleep in underground magma ever since it fiercely fought KYOGRE long ago.
pokedex.384: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.
pokedex.385: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.
pokedex.386: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.
pokedex.387: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.
pokedex.388: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.
pokedex.389: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.
pokedex.390: It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.
pokedex.391: To intimidate attackers, it stretches the fire on its tail to make itself appear bigger.
pokedex.392: It uses a special kind of martial arts involving all its limbs. Its fire never goes out.
pokedex.393: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.
pokedex.394: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.
pokedex.395: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.
pokedex.396: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.
pokedex.397: It flies around forests and fields in search of bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.
pokedex.398: It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.
pokedex.399: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.
pokedex.400: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.
pokedex.401: It shakes its head back to front, causing its antennae to hit each other and sound like a xylophone.
pokedex.402: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.
pokedex.403: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.
pokedex.404: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.
pokedex.405: It has eyes that can see through anything. It spots and captures prey hiding behind objects.
pokedex.406: Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold. In spring, the bud opens and releases pollen.
pokedex.407: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.
pokedex.408: It lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its skull is as hard as iron.
pokedex.409: Its powerful head butt has enough power to shatter even the most durable things upon impact.
pokedex.410: A Pokémon that lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its facial hide is extremely hard.
pokedex.411: Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.
pokedex.412: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.
pokedex.413: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon’s body. The cloak is never shed.
pokedex.414: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by COMBEE.
pokedex.415: A Pokémon formed by three others. It busily carries sweet floral honey to VESPIQUEN.
pokedex.416: Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by COMBEE.
pokedex.417: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.
pokedex.418: It has a flotation sac that is like an inflatable collar. It floats on water with its head out.
pokedex.419: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.
pokedex.420: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.
pokedex.421: It blooms during times of strong sunlight. It tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.
pokedex.422: Its colors and shapes differ from region to region. In the Sinnoh region, two types are confirmed.
pokedex.423: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.
pokedex.424: To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails. It rarely uses its arms now.
pokedex.425: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.
pokedex.426: It’s drowzy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.
pokedex.427: It slams foes by sharply uncoiling its rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.
pokedex.428: An extremely cautious Pokémon. It cloaks its body with its fluffy ear fur when it senses danger.
pokedex.429: Its cries sound like incantations. Those hearing it are tormented by headaches and hallucinations.
pokedex.430: Becoming active at night, it is known to swarm with numerous MURKROW in tow.
pokedex.431: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.
pokedex.432: It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon’s nest and claims it as its own.
pokedex.433: It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.
pokedex.434: It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.
pokedex.435: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.
pokedex.436: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.
pokedex.437: One caused a news sensation when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2,000-year sleep.
pokedex.438: It looks as if it is always crying. It is actually adjusting its body’s fluid levels by eliminating excess.
pokedex.439: It habitually mimics foes. Once mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes off this Pokémon.
pokedex.440: It loves round white things. It carries an egg-shaped rock in imitation of CHANSEY.
pokedex.441: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.
pokedex.442: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.
pokedex.443: It nests in small, horizontal holes in cave walls. It pounces to catch prey that stray too close.
pokedex.444: There is a long-held belief that medicine made from its scales will heal even incurable illnesses.
pokedex.445: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.
pokedex.446: It wolfs down its weight in food once a day, swallowing food whole with almost no chewing.
pokedex.447: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.
pokedex.448: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.
pokedex.449: It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.
pokedex.450: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.
pokedex.451: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.
pokedex.452: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.
pokedex.453: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.
pokedex.454: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.
pokedex.455: It attracts prey with its sweet- smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.
pokedex.456: After long exposure to sunlight, the patterns on its tail fins shine vividly when darkness arrives.
pokedex.457: It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.
pokedex.458: A friendly Pokémon that captures the subtle flows of seawater using its two antennae.
pokedex.459: It lives on snowy mountains. Having had little contact with humans, it is boldly inquisitive.
pokedex.460: It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.
pokedex.461: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.
pokedex.462: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.
pokedex.463: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.
pokedex.464: It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. GEODUDE are shot at rare times.
pokedex.465: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.
pokedex.466: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.
pokedex.467: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.
pokedex.468: It will never appear where there is strife. Its sightings have become rare recently.
pokedex.469: By churning its wings, it creates shock waves that inflict critical internal injuries to foes.
pokedex.470: Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis. As a result, it is always enveloped in clear air.
pokedex.471: As a protective technique, it can completely freeze its fur to make its hairs stand like needles.
pokedex.472: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!
pokedex.473: Its impressive tusks are made of ice. The population thinned when it turned warm after the ice age.
pokedex.474: Additional software was installed to make it a better Pokémon. It began acting oddly, however.
pokedex.475: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.
pokedex.476: It exudes strong magnetism from all over. It controls three small units called Mini-Noses.
pokedex.477: The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.
pokedex.478: It freezes foes with an icy breath nearly -60 degrees F. What seems to be its body is actually hollow.
pokedex.479: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.
pokedex.480: Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.
pokedex.481: Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.
pokedex.482: Known as “The Being of Willpower.” It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.
pokedex.483: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.
pokedex.484: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.
pokedex.485: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.
pokedex.486: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.
pokedex.487: A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.
pokedex.488: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.
pokedex.489: A Pokémon that lives in warm seas. It inflates the flotation sac on its head to drift and search for food.
pokedex.490: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.
pokedex.491: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.
pokedex.492: It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant.
pokedex.493: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.
